claims.evidence: Witness report shows an LPG cylinder with protective wire mesh and a visible valve area, but does not show capacity markings (kg) or any readable compliance/brand/label to confirm '12kg' or 'foreign'.

risks.risk: Capacity/size may not be 12kg (could be different cylinder size), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the cylinder’s capacity marking/label (kg) and any stamped serial/compliance markings near the top or body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity used LPG cylinder (worst-case for buyer value).

risks.risk: Fill level is unknown (empty vs partially/fully filled).
risks.proof: A photo showing the gauge/weight marking (if present) or a close-up of any fill/weight stamp; plus a short clip showing the cylinder being weighed (scale reading).

risks.risk: Leak risk at valve/regulator connection; hose/regulator condition not shown.
risks.proof: A clip of a leak test (soap-bubble test) at the valve/regulator connection and a photo showing the regulator and hose clearly (brand/model and condition).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-safe; treat as needing servicing/testing.

risks.risk: Valve threads/regulator interface may be worn or damaged, affecting safe connection.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the valve threads/connection area with good lighting, plus a photo of the regulator coupling fully seated.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially requiring valve/regulator replacement.

risks.risk: Safety compliance/inspection status unknown (manufacturing date, inspection stamp, and markings).
risks.proof: Clear photo of any inspection/manufacturing date stamp and compliance markings on the cylinder body.

risks.risk: Structural integrity unknown beyond minor scuffs (dents, rust-through, internal corrosion).
risks.proof: Full-body photos from multiple angles showing dents, rust, and any pitting; include a close-up of any suspicious spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average-wear used cylinder with possible hidden corrosion.

risks.risk: Protective mesh/frame may be loose or damaged (not fully verified).
risks.proof: A clip showing the mesh/frame attachment points and that it is firmly secured all around (tap/hand-check visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if mesh/frame condition is uncertain.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the cylinder’s capacity marking/label showing the kg rating.
Clear photo of brand/compliance/inspection stamps (manufacturing date and any regulatory markings).
Photo(s) of the regulator and hose (if included) showing brand/model and condition.
Short video of a soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connection.
Full-body photos from multiple angles to check for dents, rust-through, and pitting.
If possible, a clip showing the cylinder being weighed or any fill/weight indicator.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an LPG gas cylinder with protective mesh guard, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, capacity, fill level, leak safety, and compliance are not shown, so the price should reflect those uncertainties until proof is provided.
